text_block_list.text:
"I came to the shopping mall with Seiun 
Sky and Grass Wonder."

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Ah. Found the incense, Grass-chan~

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
My, thank you very much. There are so 
many~.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
I wonder which one helps you fall asleep 
faster?

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Incense to help you sleep peacefully, 
huh... Guess that's completely irrelevant 
to me.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
"Give Sei-chan about three seconds, and 
she can fall asleep anytime, anywhere."

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Fufu... Sei-chan, your easygoing nature is 
truly worthy of respect.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Now then... It seems there are electronic 
censers for testing, so let's try a few 
out.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: First, sandalwood—

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Yeah... It's such a calming, lovely 
scent...

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: ...Ghh.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Wait, huh? ...Sei-chan? Hellooo~?

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: *Gasp*... Huh?

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: ......Was I sleeping?

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: I see... Well, well, well...

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
"...Shall we try the lavender scent 
next?♪"

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Wait... Grass-chan, hold on—

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Ngh...

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Nyahaha... Found you, Grass-chan... Next 
is... my turn to hide... zzz.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Oh, my~ Playing hide-and-seek in a 
lavender field, are we?

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Well then, how about this lemon scent...?

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
...Grass-chan... maybe that's enough? 
Swallowing a whole lemon... is just... 
whoa...
choice_data_list: Things have gotten pretty crazy, huh...

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Fufufu, oh, Sei-chan. I would never do 
something like that~?

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
To think it would work this well...♪ Shall 
we test it out just a little bit more~?

And so, trying one incense after 
another...

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Curry incense is quite unusual, isn't it~? 
Let's finish off with this one.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Mnh... Curry for today, huh... Smells 
deli—wait, we're eating it 
two-in-a-coat...?

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Wait, wait, let it cool down more... Ow, 
hot! I told you it's hooot...!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
No way, no way, no way, absolutely no 
waaaay!!
choice_data_list: It's okay, it's just a dream.
It's okay, it's just a dream.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Huh... A dream...?

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Ufufu, it seems the aroma of curry isn't 
quite suited for falling asleep after 
all~. Good to know♪

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
...Grass-chaaan. You were just messing 
with me halfway through, weren't you?

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
No, no, don't mention it. I was just 
taking my time picking out the fragrance, 
you know?

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Hmm...

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: ...What do you think, Trainer?
choice_data_list: Maybe I was just messing around...

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: ...What do you think, Trainer?
choice_data_list: Maybe I was just messing around...

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
I knew it~! Geez, even Sei-chan's gonna 
get a little mad at this point.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
...Gotcha wide open! Time for you to sleep 
too, Grass-chan! Incense attaaack—

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Zzz…… zzz…… zzz……

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: My, oh my~...

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: ...Maybe I should take a photo?

Seiun Sky self-destructing, huh... I feel 
like I just witnessed something 
extraordinarily rare.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: "Ehh? I wonder if that's true~?"

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Mmm, then to apologize for the 
misunderstanding and thank you for your 
help—

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
"Please accept this 'Catnip Pouch 
Keychain' as a gift♪"

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Mmh...

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: ...Can't be helped then, nya.

To play Seiun Sky right into the palm of 
her hand... Grass Wonder is truly 
terrifying!
